what: You (Ben, 10:27: one purpose): what selling brought in after fees, with at most two numbers under it (on its way, live), then one-line rows into each page: Insights and Payouts; Your sites (a quiet Signed out when a site signed the person out), Rules and limits, Notifications, Settings. The analytics, the money's parts, signing back in, Activity and Records live behind those rows.

frame.who: Every seller; the person clearing out (primary) opens it after a sale to see the money, the flipper most days for the running total and the trend (product/personas.md; research/today/ben/top-of-today-and-stacking.md §1).
frame.how_often: A few times a week; Today's top slot taps through to it after a sale (spec/pages.md §4).
frame.came_to: See at a glance that it worked and how it is going, then reach the page for any detail in one tap: the numbers behind it (Insights), the money (Payouts), a site, a rule, an alert or a setting.
frame.costly_mistake: Reading money that can still be taken back as money in hand: on its way is its own number, never added to what came. A site that signed the person out going unnoticed: Your sites carries a quiet Signed out tag, the one row that says more than its name, and Today carries the sign-in card.
frame.ways_out: Pause selling, never suggest edits, units, delete (Settings); quiet hours and every kind of alert (Notifications); unlink a site (Your sites); undo what the agent did (Activity); turn a rule back to asking (Rules and limits). spec/ways-out.md rows: I'm away, Not at night, Don't edit my photos, Inches not centimetres, Get me out.
frame.in_the_loop: The person stays in the loop through Rules and limits (what runs alone, what always asks), with Activity (every automatic step with Undo) one row inside it.

decisions: One purpose (Ben, 10:27: "each page should have one purpose ... profile shouldnt have analytics, linking services, tracking things, settings ... it should have simple ways to visualize and understand intutitively and go to each thing"): see at a glance how it is going, and get to each thing. Read as iOS Settings reads: the account on top, then rows.

The glance is the amount that came after fees with its count of sales (Art. 7.10, one number first), and at most two numbers under it: what is on its way, and how many things are live. Why: the money is why a person opens You; on its way is money not yet theirs, so it is never added in; live is what is still working for them. Everything else is a page.

Rows are one line each, an icon, the page's own title and a chevron, in two groups: the numbers (Insights, Payouts), then how it runs (Your sites, Rules and limits, Notifications, Settings). A row's label is its page's title, as iOS Settings rows are, so the person lands where the row said.

A row says more than its name only when it needs the person: Your sites carries a quiet Signed out tag when a site signed them out. Why: the fix is on Your sites (Retry on that site's row), and Today carries the sign-in card; a gray tag keeps the color for the one thing first (Art. 7.14).

Moved, not deleted: the week chart, Your things and How they're doing open at the top of Insights (app/src/you/trends.tsx); paid out and on its way, on Payouts; Activity, under Rules and limits; Records, under Settings; App defaults (pickup spot, ship or pickup), under Settings, as before.

No Pickups row yet: no page holds pickups alone, and a row named Pickups that opened App defaults would land the person somewhere it did not name. Pickup defaults stay under Settings, App defaults, until a Pickups page exists.
Insights waits for a thing to sell or to list; Payouts waits for a sale.
Money that came is You got, after fees, as on an item's sale (app/src/item/model.ts); money to come is You get. Never You keep (Ben 06:19).
No goal on You: Ben 06:19, 'I don't really like the November goal type thing'. The goal the person sets stays on Insights.
